name: fable-advisor
description: A read-only Fable advisor subagent your session consults for architectural decisions, plan reviews, stalled debugging and change-set verification — dispatched through the fable alias, so it tracks the newest Fable release (Fable 5.1 today), with automatic Opus fallback when Fable is unavailable. Ships enforcement hooks: the advisor policy is injected every session (and after every compaction), ExitPlanMode is gated on a consultation, unreviewed edits trigger nudges, and a turn that edits 4+ files unadvised is held for a verification review. Replaces reliance on the built-in advisor tool.
